newsitem.title: DUBAI: Dubai Aluminium plans $160mln cells upgrade - paper.
newsitem.headline: Dubai Aluminium plans $160mln cells upgrade - paper.

text.p: Dubai Aluminium Co Ltd (Dubal) plans to implement a four-year project costing around $160 million to upgrade some cells at its smelter, finance director Samir al-Ansari was quoted as saying.
The daily Arabic-language al-Khaleej newspaper on Thursday quoted Ansari as saying the project would modernise and upgrade cells at the smelter over the next four years.
The upgrade had become necessary as the cells had been operating for 17 years and Dubal wanted to ensure the high quality of its product, he said.
Dubal will pay for the project from internal resources.
The paper said the project would be implemented gradually so as not to disrupt production and exports.
Government-owned Dubal is in the process of expanding annual capacity by over 50 percent to 375,000 tonnes.
